definition: a humorous writing.
example_en: A humorous writing has been published in that magazine.

definition: the light that has golden hue.
example_en: The golden morning light spread over the hills.

definition: a broad, flat, movable piece of wood or metal hinged vertically at the stern of a boat or ship, used for steering; a rudder.
example_en: He turned the boat's rudder to the right.

definition: the front hall or room where guests are received; drawing room.
example_en: All the relatives were seated in the wedding house's drawing room.

definition: controlling; having power to control, check, restrain, etc.
example: ಈ ಇಲಾಖೆಗೆ ನಿಯಾಮಕ ಅಧಿಕಾರಿಗಳ ಅವಶ್ಯಕತೆ ಇದೆ.
example_en: This department needs controlling officers.

definition: the plant Solanum nigrum of Solanaceae family.
example_en: The bellagaṇike plant has grown in the garden.

definition: of or relating to war, military ammunition; military.
example: ಈ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗೆ ಒಂದು ವಿಶೇಷ ಪರಿಹಾರ ಬೇಕಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: A special solution is needed for this problem.

definition: a beautiful woman; a charming lady.
example_en: Everyone admired that charming woman on seeing her.

definition: a variety of linseed flax tree.
example_en: Linseed flax plants of this variety had grown at the edge of the garden.

definition: completely unclothed; bare; nude; naked.
example_en: The child was playing completely naked.

definition: a small, supple, soft-furred, domesticated carnivore, Felis domestica or F. catus of Felidae family, bred in a number of varieties; a cat.
example_en: That cat chased the rat.

definition: the act or an instance of flogging with a lash; a lashing or whipping.
example_en: They gave the criminal a lashing and released him.

definition: a member of the genus Perdix, Perdix sylvatica; a partridge.
example_en: The hunters went into the forest searching for a partridge.

definition: the root of the year.
example_en: She brought the root of the year for cooking.

definition: comfortably; cozily.
example_en: The child was sleeping cozily under the blanket.

definition: a coming together.
example_en: The confluence of the two rivers happens right here.

definition: the act or an instance of getting some thing (esp. a heavy log or a mob of people) pushed forward or aside.
example_en: They pushed the crowd aside with a forward shove.

definition: the grass zea mayis of Poaceae family.
example_en: We had grown maize in the backyard of the house.

definition: a leaf of a plantain tree.
example_en: She served the rice on a plantain leaf.

definition: a thin, sharp piece of wood; a splinter.
example_en: A splinter from the wood went into his hand.

definition: the string of a bow.
example_en: The archer pulled the bowstring tight.

definition: a kind of eagle that is reddish in colour.
example: ಆ ಕೆಂಪು ಬಣ್ಣದ ಚೇಪರ್ದು ಮರದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That reddish eagle was perched on the tree.

definition: any of various skin disorders accompanied by severe irritation of the skin; the itch.
example_en: That soap gave him a skin itch.

definition: the act, process or practice of bringing into or taking out of a country secretely, illegally, without paying the required import or export duties; a smuggling transaction.
example_en: The police stopped the smuggling at the border.

definition: filled with or covered by, water.
example_en: The whole ground was covered with water due to the rain.

definition: an ear the lobe of which hangs down considerably.
example: ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಗಲ್ಲಗಿವಿ ಇರುವ ಕಾರಣ ಆಭರಣ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Because she has an ear with a long hanging lobe, the ornament looks good.

definition: a reply; a response.
example_en: A reply to the letter has not come yet.

definition: a spark thrown off by a fire.
example_en: A spark thrown off by the fire burnt the cloth.

definition: of the colour that is characteristic of growing grass or foliage; green.
example_en: The green leaves swayed in the wind.

definition: to come forth (from within, as to be seen).
example_en: The sprout came forth from the soil.

definition: a trifle, paltry scandal; an attempted discredit upon a person or organisation, on a false ground.
example: ಅವನ ಮೇಲೆ ಆ ಪತ್ರಿಕೆ ಕಾಕುವಗರಣ ಪ್ರಕಟಿಸಿ ಅವಮಾನಿಸಿತು.
example_en: That newspaper published a scandalous, false accusation and insulted him.

definition: the art or knowledge of coking.
example_en: She learned the art of cooking from her mother-in-law.

definition: to lick another's feet.
example_en: He licked his master's feet out of selfishness.

definition: a man going ahead of others.
example_en: That scientist is a pioneer in his field.

definition: the cry of an Indian cuckoo; a sound imitating it.
example_en: The cuckoo's cry was heard from the forest at dawn.

definition: the earth.
example_en: Life forms grow in the lap of the earth.

definition: a large piece of cloth, often of soft wool, used to wrap up a person for warmth; a blanket.
example_en: In winter, she wrapped herself in a warm blanket.

definition: the particles that carry sweet fragrance.
example_en: The fragrant particles floated in on the breeze.

definition: an oral examination (diff. from the written one, where examinees are supposed to write their answers, etc.).
example_en: I have an oral examination tomorrow.

definition: to a relatively high degree; in a very powerful, forceful manner.
example_en: The fire burned very fiercely and spread everywhere.

definition: a fortified place in a sea.
example_en: That kingdom's sea-fort was invincible to enemies.

definition: having no characteristic marks; having no marks.
example: ಆ ಬಟ್ಟೆಯು ಅಲಿಂಗವಾಗಿತ್ತು, ಯಾವ ಗುರುತೂ ಇರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That cloth was markless, having no marks at all.

definition: an indeclinable used to express the sense 'it is', 'it is available'.
example_en: There is still rice available at home.

definition: to search, examine, thoroughly.
example: ಪೊಲೀಸರು ಇಡೀ ಮನೆಯನ್ನು ಎಂಪರಲಾಡಿಸಿ ಸಾಕ್ಷ್ಯ ಹುಡುಕಿದರು.
example_en: The police thoroughly searched the whole house looking for evidence.

definition: (fig.) to cause anotehr to shed one's blood; to kill (another person heinously).
example_en: That cruel man killed his enemy heinously, shedding his blood.

definition: an archaic monitory coin.
example_en: He kept the monitory coin in his pocket.

definition: a kind of bird (the lapwing, Vanellus indicus of Charadriidae family?).
example_en: The lapwing called loudly near the field.

definition: a female horse; a mare.
example: ರೈತನ ಬಳಿ ಒಂದು ಬಿಳಿ ಘೋಳಿಗೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: The farmer had a white mare.

definition: the condition of or legal entitlement to, enjoying the benefits.
example_en: He legally obtained entitlement to enjoy the benefits of the property.

definition: a washing of the feet (of respectable persons).
example: ಅತಿಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಅಡಿಗಚ್ಚು ಮಾಡಿ ಅವರನ್ನು ಒಳಗೆ ಕರೆದುಕೊಂಡು ಹೋದರು.
example_en: They washed the guests' feet and led them inside.

definition: an offspring; a descendant; an issue.
example: ಆ ಮನೆಯ ಸೂತಗ ಈಗ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಉದ್ಯಮಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದಾನೆ.
example_en: The offspring of that family is now a big businessman.

definition: that which burns; the condition of burning.
example_en: Walking in the sun, he felt a burning thirst.

definition: a younger sister.
example_en: The younger sister had come for her brother's wedding.

definition: (Jain.) a man who has overcome the desire for sensual pleasures.
example_en: That monk, having overcome sensual desires, renounced worldly life.

definition: a kind of disease.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಅವನಿಗೆ ಸಂಧಿಗ ರೋಗವಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor said he had the disease called sandhiga.

definition: a mature female of domestic cattle (genus Bos), valued for its milk; cow.
example: ಆಕಳು ಹಸುವನ್ನು ಕರೆದುಕೊಂಡು ಹೋಗಿ ಹಾಲು ಕರೆದರು.
example_en: They took the cow to the shed and milked it.

definition: the act of discussing; talk or writing in which the pros and cons or various aspects of a subject are considered; a discussion.
example: ಆ ವಿಷಯದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸಾಂಖ್ಯ ಬಹಳ ಹೊತ್ತು ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The discussion about that subject went on for a long time.

definition: sweet speech; a sweet language.
example_en: The poet's sweet speech delighted the people's hearts.

definition: a dream or series of dreams prompted by tender and gentle feelings.
example_en: The child slept smiling in a sweet dream.

definition: a building or hall where trials are held, official investigations are made, and law is dispensed; the official premises of the court of law.
example: ಆ ವ್ಯಾಜ್ಯ ಅದಾಲತು ಕಚೇರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಚಾರಣೆಗೆ ಬಂತು.
example_en: That dispute came up for trial at the court building.

definition: a particular kind of game of boys.
example_en: The boys were playing the game of tilali in the open field.

definition: a form of arthritis characterised by cartilages deterioration and bone enlargement; osteo-arthritis.
example_en: Many people get osteo-arthritis as they grow old.

definition: a man having squint eyes.
example_en: When the squint-eyed man turned to look, everyone noticed.

definition: the sun-setting time.
example_en: By the sun-setting time, the sky turned red.

definition: to be excited by joy, love, success, etc.; to be carried away by such events.
example_en: In the feeling of love, she was carried away with excitement.

definition: a man having an obsession.
example_en: He is a great obsessive collector of books.

definition: the lower jaw; the mandible.
example_en: His lower jaw got hurt and it caused him pain.

definition: that which is barren, sterile.
example_en: Due to the drought, the field became barren.

definition: a man who rubs, kneads, etc. another's body with the hands to stimulate circulation and make muscles or joints supple, relieve rension, etc.; to massage.
example: ಆ ಮೆಯ್ಮೇಟಿ ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಎಣ್ಣೆ ಹಚ್ಚಿ ಮೈ ತಿಕ್ಕುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That masseur applies oil and massages the body every day.

definition: a long time past; a very ancient times.
example_en: This temple has existed here since ancient times.

definition: the room adjacent to and in front of the sanctum sanctorum of a temple.
example: ಭಕ್ತರು ಗರ್ಭಾಂಗಣದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಂತು ದೇವರ ದರ್ಶನಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: The devotees stood in the room in front of the sanctum and waited to see the deity.

definition: an inner portion of a house; inner apartments.
example_en: The queen lived in the inner apartments of the palace.

definition: to reach (something) by stretching one's hand.
example_en: The boy reached the upper branch by stretching his hand.

definition: excessive grief.
example_en: Seeing that excessive grief, the neighbours too wept.

definition: the act of joining, harnessing, coupling.
example: ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಹೊಸ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ವಿಧಾನವನ್ನು ಜಾರಿಗೆ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: The government implemented a new organisation of education.

definition: the quality of being ideal or exemplary; exemplariness.
example_en: That teacher's exemplariness was an inspiration to the students.

definition: the tree Gmelina arborea (= Premna arborea) of Verbenaceae family; Cashmere tree.
example_en: There was a big Cashmere tree near the village.

definition: to shield from injury, danger or loss; to guard, defend; to protect.
example_en: The soldiers protected the border diligently.

definition: either of the two fleshy, rounded parts at the back of the hips; the buttock.
example_en: When he fell, his buttock hurt.

definition: an eye that is opened wide.
example_en: She looked at everything with wide open eyes.

definition: a government department for collecting revenue.
example_en: The officer of the revenue department came to the village.

definition: the thick, slimy secretion of the mucous membranes in the nose, that moistens and protects them; mucus of the nose.
example_en: The child had a cold and mucus was running from the nose.

definition: (said of cattle) to eat; to graze.
example_en: The cattle were grazing on the hill.

definition: giving fruits or that gives fruits.
example_en: This tree is known for giving fruits.

definition: to push oneself in or enter forcibly.
example_en: He pushed himself into the crowd.

definition: an infectious venereal disease caused by gonococci, characterised by inflammation of the mucous membrane of the genitourinary tract and a discharge of mucous and pus; gonorrhoea.
example_en: The disease gonorrhoea is cured with medical treatment.

definition: the quality of being gigantic, colossal; gigantism.
example_en: The colossal size of that statue amazed everyone.

definition: a loose long unsewn cloth used as a cover for shoulders.
example_en: In the cold, he wrapped himself in a loose long cloth.

definition: old age.
example_en: He has now reached old age.

definition: the plant Zingibe zerumbet of Zingiberaceae family.
example_en: The wild ginger plant had grown at the edge of the forest.

definition: happened; befallen; occured.
example_en: That tragedy occurred in our town.

definition: an indeclinable word used to express anger, force, etc.
example_en: He exclaimed "kava" in anger.

definition: the chest - a) the part of the body enclosed by the ribs, breastbone, and diaphragm; thorax; b) the outside front part of this.
example_en: The arrow pierced his chest.

definition: to get or perceive the right meaning of; to know or grasp what is actually meant by.
example_en: One must grasp the right meaning of the teacher's instruction.

definition: to slip down or away (loosening oneself from another's grip or hold).
example_en: The boy slipped away from the hand and ran off.

definition: to excite the surface nerves of, as by touching or stroking lightly with the finger, a feather, etc., so as to cause involuntary twitching, a pleasant tingling, laughter, etc.; to tickle.
example_en: The elder sister tickled her younger sister's foot and made her laugh.

definition: accidentally; unexpectedly.
example_en: The door opened unexpectedly.

definition: the wooden beam serving as support for roof.
example_en: The roof's supporting beam had become weak.

definition: to strike heavily against; to dash; to make rapid sweeping movement or onset, to rush with violence; to lash.
example_en: In the storm the waves dashed against the rock.

definition: to be cold or chilly; to have coldness.
example_en: The child, drenched in the rain, became chilly.

definition: impure carbonate of soda; hydrated sodium carbonate; natron.
example_en: She used natron (sarjike) for washing clothes.

definition: a U-shaped moustache.
example_en: The soldier's U-shaped moustache caught everyone's attention.

definition: tired; fatigued.
example: ದೀರ್ಘ ಪ್ರಯಾಣದ ನಂತರ ಅವನು ತಾಂತನಾಗಿ ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: After the long journey, he looked tired and fatigued.

definition: an overstepping; an infringement; a transgression.
example_en: He committed a transgression of the rules.

definition: the soil rich in various salts; saline earth.
example_en: It is difficult to grow crops in the saline soil of the coast.

definition: a celestial woman.
example_en: In the poem, the celestial woman is described as beautiful.

definition: to flow over the brim, edge or limits of; to overflow.
example: ಪಾತ್ರೆಯ ಹಾಲು ಉಕ್ಕಾಡಿ ಒಲೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The milk in the vessel overflowed and spilled onto the stove.

definition: a wooden structure built over a stream, small river, etc. for crossing over from one side to another; a wooden bridge.
example: ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಜನ ಹೊಳೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಒಂದು ಸಾರು ಕಟ್ಟಿದರು.
example_en: The village people built a wooden bridge over the stream.

definition: the condition of being irritated from annoyance; mental irritation.
example_en: He felt irritated by the repeated calls.

definition: the large-sized, deciduous tree Cedrela toona (= Toona ciliata) of Meliaceae family, with reddish wood, used for making tea-chests, furniture, etc.
example: ನೊಗೆ ಮರದ ಕೆಂಪು ಕಟ್ಟಿಗೆಯಿಂದ ಅವರು ಟೀ ಪೆಟ್ಟಿಗೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: They make tea chests from the reddish wood of the toon tree.

definition: ho! ho! - a term used calling servants.
example_en: Ho there! Come quickly and hold the horse.

definition: a plant.
example_en: The kalyadarasi plant has flowered in the garden.

definition: a person who herds and takes care of sheep; a shepherd.
example_en: The shepherd took the sheep to the field early in the morning.

definition: to levy a tax (on a building used for dwelling).
example_en: The government levied a tax on the houses.

definition: a thing presented as a gift; a present.
example_en: He offered a present to the guru.

definition: a fund, money saved, for the welfare or a secured future; a thrift fund.
example_en: He had kept his thrift fund in the bank.

definition: younger; not old.
example_en: This boy is younger than that boy.

definition: to utter a deep, mournful sound expressive of pain or grief; to groan.
example_en: He groaned in pain from his broken leg.

definition: a timber supporting the roof; a rigid support; a prop.
example_en: They fixed a sturdy prop for the house's roof.

definition: the safron-cloth used by mendicants, religious or saintly persons.
example_en: The ascetic was wearing the saffron cloth.

definition: of poor, shabby or inferior quality or status; mean.
example: ಅವನ ಅದನಾ ಬಟ್ಟೆಗಳನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ ಜನ ನಗಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: People laughed on seeing his shabby, inferior clothes.

definition: the colour of charcoal; black colour.
example_en: The wall took on a black colour from the smoke of the fire.

definition: the profession of a teacher.
example_en: He carries out the profession of a teacher with respect.

definition: to stop; to desist from (making, acting, doing, etc.).
example_en: Please stop doing this work.

definition: range or limits of anything; scope; coverage.
example_en: The scope of this project is wide.

definition: a very small piece chopped off from a whole.
example_en: A tiny crumb of bread fell on the floor.

definition: smeared; anointed; perfumed.
example: ಪೂಜೆಯ ಮೊದಲು ಮೂರ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಗಂಧದಿಂದ ಚರ್ಚಿತ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: Before the worship, they anointed the idol with sandalwood paste.

definition: a precious carpet.
example_en: A precious carpet had been spread on the palace floor.

definition: to be charmed greatly; to enchanted.
example_en: Seeing that scene, she was greatly enchanted.

definition: the act or an instance of becoming one; unification; integration.
example_en: The unification of all castes is the aim of society.

definition: to become less in extent.
example_en: In the famine, the crop became less in extent.

definition: the plant Phaseolus adenanthus of Papilionaceae family.
example_en: The adavihesaru plant is found at the side of the forest.

definition: to be spoiled; to get damaged, injured in such a way as to become useless.
example_en: The books got soaked in the rain and were spoiled.

definition: the mentally or emotionally disturbed state.
example_en: Her mind was caught in a disturbed state.

definition: to score or mark the surface of (something) with a nail or nails.
example_en: He scratched the paper with his nails.

definition: to disapprove - a) to have or express an unfavourable opinion of; b) to refuse to approve; to reject.
example_en: The committee disapproved of that proposal.

definition: a container for oil.
example_en: They had kept the oil container in the corner of the kitchen.

definition: causing, producing annoyance, disaster, evil or disease; harmful, malignant, destructive; malefic.
example_en: Destructive insects destroyed the crops.

definition: a man born in a royal family.
example_en: Born into a royal family, he always did good for the people.

definition: a joining together or being joined together; union; association; conjunction.
example_en: There are many hymns in the collection of that scripture.

definition: a word ending with a consonant.
example_en: There are many consonant-ending words in this poem.

definition: a medicine that causes ejection of the contents of the stomach through the mouth.
example_en: The doctor gave an emetic for the poison.

definition: an unripe lemon fruit.
example_en: She squeezed the juice of an unripe lemon into the curry.

definition: the diver bird, water crow.
example: ನೀರುಕಾಗೆ ಸರೋವರದ ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಳುಗಿ ಆಹಾರ ಹುಡುಕಿತು.
example_en: The water crow dived into the lake to search for food.

definition: the quality of giving or spending grudgingly or only through necessity; stinginess; parsimony.
example_en: Because of his stinginess, he helped no one.

definition: a report of a recent event.
example_en: A report of the town's recent event was published in the newspaper.

definition: a headline - a) a line at the top of a page in a book, giving the running title, page number, etc. ; b) a line, usu. in larger type, at the top of a newspaper article, giving a short statement of its contents; c) an important item of news.
example_en: There was a headline at the top of the page.

definition: any of various small, strong, two-wheeled vehicles drawn by an ox or usu. two oxen.
example: ರೈತ ಚಕಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎತ್ತುಗಳನ್ನು ಕಟ್ಟಿ ಪೇಟೆಗೆ ಹೊರಟನು.
example_en: The farmer yoked the oxen to the chakaḍi and set out for the market.

definition: a man of wicked devices; a man who works with evil intent; a machinator.
example: ಕುತಂತ್ರಗಾರ ತನ್ನ ಯೋಜನೆಯಿಂದ ಊರಿಗೆ ಹಾನಿ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: The schemer harmed the village with his plot.

definition: a long stride or step, in walking.
example_en: He walked quickly, taking long strides.

definition: to bite and grind or crush with the teeth; to masticate; to chew.
example_en: Grandmother chews roasted chickpeas in winter.

definition: a variety in cassia plant.
example_en: The white cassia plant bears white flowers.

definition: a small, usu. microscopic mass of protoplasm bounded externally by a semi permeable membrane, usu. including one or more nuclei and various other organelles with their products, capable alone or interacting with other cells of performing all the fundamental functions of life, and forming the smallest structural unit of living matter capable of functioning independently; a cell.
example: ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಜೀವಿಯ ದೇಹವೂ ಅಸಂಖ್ಯ ಜೀವಕೋಶಗಳಿಂದ ಕೂಡಿದೆ.
example_en: Every living being's body is made up of countless cells.

definition: the business of giving and recovering loans; the lending business.
example_en: That merchant was engaged in the lending business.

definition: (jain.) that which provides sensual pleasures.
example: ಜೈನ ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಸದ್ವೇದ್ಯ ಎಂಬುದು ಸುಖಕಾರಕ ಕರ್ಮ.
example_en: In Jain scripture, sadvedya is the karma that provides sensual pleasures.

definition: one who is not a performer.
example_en: He was merely a non-performer in that work.

definition: (said of a liquid) the act of trickling, flowing, oozing or dropping.
example_en: Water was slowly trickling and oozing from the wall.

definition: thermodynamic - a) of or having to do with thermodynamics; b) caused or operated by heat converted into motive power.
example: ಈ ಎಂಜಿನ್ ಉಷ್ಣಗತ್ಯಾತ್ಮಕ ತತ್ವಗಳ ಆಧಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: This engine works based on thermodynamic principles.

definition: having or showing tolerance of disagreement or conflicting opinion.
example_en: That teacher is a person of tolerant nature toward disagreement.

definition: the quality, fact of being extended over a wide area.
example: ಈ ಕಾಡಿನ ನಿಗುರಿಕೆ ಹಲವು ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಗಳಿಗೆ ವ್ಯಾಪಿಸಿದೆ.
example_en: The extent of this forest spreads across many districts.

definition: a kind of cot made by intertwining a coarse, broad tape, on a frame.
example_en: There was an old tape cot in the courtyard.

definition: an anti-cyclic rotation.
example_en: Scientists observed the anti-cyclic rotation of that planet.

definition: to divide (a whole) into parts, groups, etc.
example_en: He divided the property among the children.

definition: a man of self-conceit, arrogarance.
example_en: That arrogant man listens to no one's word.

definition: (body tissue) to bruise by or as by a blow.
example_en: When he fell, his knee bruised.

definition: to attach or fasten with or as with a hook.
example_en: The hunter fastened the fish onto the hook.

definition: a poet who sings ballads and songs, esp. on the past heroes.
example: ಆ ಶಾವೀರ ಹಿಂದಿನ ವೀರರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಹಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That ballad-singer used to sing about past heroes.

definition: a small flat ornament, with a jewel, worn as a frontlet at the partition of hair in combing.
example_en: She combed her hair and placed the frontlet ornament on her parting.

definition: one of the Dravidian languages.
example: ಒರೇಯನ್ ಭಾಷೆ ಭಾರತದ ಪೂರ್ವ ಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತನಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The Oriya language is spoken in the eastern part of India.

definition: to look on with scorn; to disdain; to despise.
example_en: The rich looked upon the poor with scorn.

definition: a literary composition meant to be enacted as a drama.
example_en: They staged this dramatic literary composition on the theatre.

definition: a man in charge of a department, institution, etc.; a supervisor; a superintendent.
example_en: The supervisor inspected the office's work.

definition: the act of going.
example_en: His act of going was very fast.

definition: a preconceived idea or opinion.
example_en: His preconceived idea did not let him know the truth.

definition: a broken, hence useless, cowrie.
example_en: The children used only a broken, useless cowrie in the game.

definition: fire.
example_en: The fire burned everything down.

definition: a violent storm with high winds; tornado; hurricane.
example: ಈ ವರ್ಷ ದೊಡ್ಡ ತುಫಾನಿ ಬರುವ ಸಾಧ್ಯತೆ ಇದೆ.
example_en: There is a possibility of a big hurricane coming this year.

definition: a natural raised part of the earth's surface, usu. rising more or less abruptly; a hill.
example_en: The whole town can be seen from the top of the hill.

definition: a group of persons who manage or control a business, administration etc. of an organisation.
example_en: The company's board of directors met and discussed.

definition: a killing of a brāhmaṇa, considered as one of the five most heinous sins.
example: ಪುರಾಣದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಬೊಮ್ಮಹತಿ ಐದು ಮಹಾಪಾಪಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು.
example_en: According to the Purana, killing a brāhmaṇa is one of the five great sins.

definition: the quality or condition of being complete or entire; completeness; wholeness; entirety.
example: ಆ ಕೆಲಸದ ನೆಱವು ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಸಂತೃಪ್ತಿ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: The completeness of that work brought satisfaction to everyone.

definition: one of the seven mother-goddesses.
example_en: They worship Cāvuṇḍi as the village deity.

definition: a written order, in a formal manner, to a bank to pay or transfer a certain amount of money from one's account; a cheque.
example_en: He wrote a cheque to the bank.

definition: not straight; crooked.
example_en: Do not draw a line with a crooked stick.

definition: a written permission for entering into (a hall, concert, theatre, etc.).
example_en: The spectators showed the entry pass and went inside.

definition: an advancement towards a better state, economic or social conditions, etc.; progress.
example_en: The investors were pleased seeing the company's progress.

definition: the fact of the physical and mental faculties becoming one as to result in complete absorption.
example_en: The seeker attained complete absorption through meditation.

definition: a particular portion of space on the surface of the earth, whether of definite or of indefinite extent; an area of land; region.
example_en: That region has fertile land.

definition: an archaic kind of poetical composition.
example: ಕವಿ ಚತ್ತಾಣ ಎಂಬ ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ ಕಾವ್ಯ ಪ್ರಕಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ಬರೆದನು.
example_en: The poet wrote in the archaic poetical form called cattana.

definition: the plant Erythroxylon monogynum, of Erythroxylaceae family; bastard cedar.
example_en: The adavigoranti plant grows abundantly in the forest.

definition: a range of rocks.
example_en: A range of rocks stretched all along the path.

definition: that is much above normal; immoderately more; excessive.
example_en: His expenditure was excessive.

definition: to face; to meet.
example_en: He did not hesitate to face the problem.

definition: name of a Hindustani musical mode.
example: ಅವನು ತಿಲಂಗ್ ರಾಗವನ್ನು ಬಹಳ ಸೊಗಸಾಗಿ ಹಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He sang the Tilang mode very beautifully.

definition: (fig.) a man who annoys constantly or repeatedly for something; a pesterer; a bother.
example: ಅವನು ನಿಜವಾದ ನಕ್ಷತ್ರೀಕ, ಪ್ರತಿದಿನವೂ ಸಾಲ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: He is a real pesterer, asking for the loan every single day.

definition: to reflect light; to be radiant; to gleam; to glow.
example_en: The moonlight gleamed upon the water.

definition: a hole, pit in the ground made to catch wild animals.
example_en: The hunters dug a pit to trap animals.

definition: a muslim king or emperor; a sultan.
example_en: In those days the sultan ruled Delhi.

definition: the flesh of animals used as food; meat.
example_en: Mutton was being sold in the market.

definition: a domesticated she-buffalo.
example_en: The domesticated she-buffalo gives milk every day.

definition: a round vessel of any size, made of earthenware, with a small mouth, used for holding liquids; a pot.
example_en: They filled water in the pot and placed it aside.

definition: a door that is closed.
example_en: He tried to push open the closed door.

definition: a true statement.
example_en: He told a true statement before the judge.

definition: indulgence in pleasure and comforts.
example_en: The rich man's son immersed himself in indulgence of pleasure and comforts.

definition: intellectual capacity.
example_en: That student's intellectual capacity is greater than everyone else's.

definition: the decision of the juries of a village.
example_en: Everyone accepted the decision of the village juries.

definition: a drinking glass with no handle or foot (formerly with a rounded bottom; a tumbler.
example_en: He poured milk into the tumbler.

definition: (rhet.) the use of a word in different senses, giving scope for different interepretation.
example: ಆ ಕವಿ ಪದ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಶ್ಲೇಷವನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ ಚಮತ್ಕರಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The poet dazzled by using wordplay in the verse.

definition: the fibrous coat of a cocoanut.
example_en: The fibrous coat of the coconut is used to make rope.

definition: the act of seeing; beholding; a looking at.
example_en: He felt joy from beholding the sky.

definition: a woman considered in relation to her husband; a wife.
example_en: His wife was skilled in household chores.

definition: the quality of wicked fellow; wickedness.
example_en: Everyone knew about his wickedness.

definition: a woman.
example_en: That woman was selling vegetables in the market.

definition: the art of using language with fluency and effectiveness.
example_en: That poet had extraordinary skill in the use of language.

definition: to anneal; to temper.
example_en: The blacksmith had the iron tempered in fire.

definition: the flow of milk, flowing out when squeezed out from the mammary glands of a cow, etc.
example_en: The milk flowed in a stream from the cow's udder.

definition: to conceive in the mind; to give mental attention to; to think over.
example_en: Think over this matter well.

definition: to redden, as from embarrassment or shame; to blush.
example_en: Getting scolded in front of everyone, she blushed with embarrassment.

definition: pain in the stomach or abdomen; stomach-ache.
example_en: She is suffering from stomach-ache.

definition: a person suffering from epilepsy.
example_en: That epileptic patient used to have fits now and then.

definition: the state or condition of being dry; dryness.
example: ಬಟ್ಟೆಯ ಕಾಚಲು ನೋಡಿ ಅವಳು ಅದನ್ನು ಮಡಚಿಟ್ಟಳು.
example_en: Seeing the dryness of the cloth, she folded it away.

definition: the place, room or building where a work is carried on; a workplace.
example_en: That factory is a large workplace.

definition: the prickly plant Tribulus terrestris of Zygophyllaceae family.
example_en: The naggalu plant had grown on the field's fence.

definition: a kind of tree.
example_en: An odavu tree had grown on the bank of the pond.

definition: a little boy or girl.
example_en: That little child was playing in the street.

definition: the pea plant Lathyrus sativus of Papilionaceae family.
example_en: The poor used to use vishatogari seeds as food.

definition: movement of the eye-lid, hence the movement of sight.
example_en: The dazzling light caused a movement of sight.

definition: to cause to touch.
example_en: The breeze brushed against the leaves and passed by.

definition: a man who shoots with great accuracy; a sharpshooter..
example_en: The sharpshooter brought down the bird with a single arrow.

definition: resulting in advantage; favourable.
example_en: This weather is favourable for the crop.

definition: poor knowledge.
example_en: Because of poor knowledge, he could not understand the lesson.

definition: a dangerous, perilous situation.
example: ಆ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ಇಡೀ ಕುಟುಂಬಕ್ಕೆ ತಲೆಗೇಡು ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: That decision brought a dangerous situation to the whole family.

definition: the chief or an excellent leader.
example_en: The chief leader of that army was very valiant.

definition: the quality of being constructed, textured or made well.
example: ಈ ಮನೆಯ ಕಟ್ಟೆಸಕ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಮೆಚ್ಚುಗೆ ಪಡೆದಿದೆ.
example_en: The fine construction of this house has won everyone's praise.

definition: a swollen part of the body; swelling.
example_en: A bee bite caused swelling on the hand.

definition: the quality of being natural; naturalness.
example: ಅವಳ ನಡವಳಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಹಜವಾದ ಸಾಜ ಎದ್ದು ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The naturalness stands out clearly in her behavior.

definition: an old coin; half a kāsu.
example_en: In olden times, the half-kasu coin was in circulation.

definition: a custom that is in practice since very long time or from time immemorial.
example: ಈ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆ ಆಚರಣೆ ಪುರಾಣಮಾರ್ಗವಾಗಿ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತಿದೆ.
example_en: In this village, that custom has been practiced since time immemorial.

definition: a very vile man.
example_en: That very vile man used to cheat everyone.

definition: a period of time for leisure or rest.
example_en: We need some period of rest amid the work.

definition: a progressive infectious disease caused by the bacterium Mycobacterium leprae that attacks the skin, flesh, nerves, etc., characterised by nodules, ulcers, white scaly scabs, deformities, and the eventual loss of sensation, and is apparently communicated only after long and close contact; leprosy.
example_en: That patient was suffering from leprosy.

definition: a grove of young trees.
example_en: Birds built nests in that grove of young trees.

definition: to flap the wings (as in flying).
example_en: The pigeon came out of the nest, flapping its wings.

definition: to bind with fetters; to shackle; to fetter.
example_en: The soldiers shackled the thief and led him away.

definition: a kind of tree.
example_en: A kadasu tree had grown at the edge of the forest.

definition: to praise highly; to laud; to commend.
example_en: The teacher praised the student's effort.

definition: a forest; jungle; woods.
example_en: That forest was filled with dense trees.

definition: a making of harsh sounds in breathing, while asleep as caused by vibration of the soft palate usu. with the mouth open; the act or sound of snoring.
example_en: His snoring continued throughout the whole night.

definition: the initial period of sowing season in a year.
example_en: In the initial period of the sowing season, farmers begin to sow seeds.

definition: a woman with abnormal curvature of the spine; a hump-backed woman.
example_en: The hump-backed woman used to help the neighbours.

definition: excessive frequency and looseness of bowel movements caused by bile disorders.
example_en: He suffered from loose bowel movements caused by bile disorders.

definition: to cook by frying in a frying pan.
example_en: Mother fried the brinjal in oil.

definition: a gathering for dancing, merriment, etc.
example_en: On the festival day, a gathering for dancing and merriment took place in the village.

definition: a ray of light.
example_en: The moon's ray spread over the pond.

definition: not available; not reachable; not obtainable.
example_en: That medicine is now unavailable in the market.

definition: a book in which a record or list of names, events or any other item, are kept; a register.
example_en: The patients' names are in the hospital's register.

definition: to wash kitchen dishes by rubbing with ash, smooth earth, etc.
example_en: The grandmother was washing the dishes by rubbing them with ash.

definition: of materialism or materialists; not believing in the existence of god, other world, etc.; materialist.
example_en: He accepts the materialist school of thought.

definition: to hear the sound or voice.
example_en: He heard the sound of thunder.

definition: a thin slab or bent piece of baked clay used for roof covering; a tile.
example_en: They covered the hut's roof with tiles.

definition: feeling thirst; wanting to drink (water).
example_en: Walking in the sun, he became thirsty.

definition: itching; having irritating sensation.
example_en: The spot bitten by the mosquito was itching.

definition: a man who inherits or has a right of inheritance in the property of another.
example_en: He alone is the rightful heir to that property.

definition: to know the time.
example_en: One must know the time before the journey.

definition: (beauty, good or natural form of a thing) to be lost, deformed, defaced or disfigured.
example_en: The paintings on the wall were disfigured by the rain water.

definition: churning of one's own ideas as to analyse oneself; deep self-introspection.
example: ಧ್ಯಾನದ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನು ಆಳವಾದ ಅಂತರ್ಮಥನಕ್ಕೆ ಒಳಗಾದನು.
example_en: During meditation, he underwent deep self-introspection.

definition: a band worn around the head.
example_en: The player tied a headband and got ready for the race.

definition: (collectively) dried sticks, twigs of plants.
example_en: Grandmother swept up the dried twigs lying in the courtyard.

definition: excelling other in quality, merit; excellent.
example: ಇದು ಅಚ್ಚಳವಾದ ಬಟ್ಟೆ ಎಂದು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: Everyone said that this was an excellent cloth.

definition: (a cattle) to reject or abandon eating fodder.
example_en: Due to illness, that buffalo rejected eating fodder.

definition: the plant Lobelia nicotianaefolia of Companulaceae family; wild tobacco.
example_en: The flower of the wild tobacco plant was blue in colour.

definition: a bundle of stalk left in fields after cutting the crops.
example: ಬೆಳೆ ಕೊಯ್ದ ಮೇಲೆ ಹೊಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಚಾಪು ಉಳಿಯಿತು.
example_en: After harvesting the crop, stalk stubble remained in the field.

definition: the early stage of youth.
example_en: He learned wrestling right in his early youth.

definition: a follower or an advocate of the theory of empiricism; empiricist.
example_en: That philosopher was famous as an empiricist.

definition: mental sufferings; agony.
example_en: Nobody understood her mental agony.

definition: the place or position directly before a person or thing.
example_en: There was a small garden in front of the house.

definition: any of several white herons of Ardeidae family, that have long, slender legs, graceful plumes, etc.; an egret.
example: ಕೆರೆಯ ದಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿಳಿ ಬಕ ಒಂಟಿಕಾಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಂತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A white egret stood on one leg at the edge of the pond.

definition: an order; a command.
example_en: The king's order was announced throughout the town.

definition: a person who eats human flesh; a cannibal.
example_en: A cannibal in the forest frightened the travellers.

definition: a king whose lineage is noble.
example: ಆ ಕುಲರಾಜ ತನ್ನ ಉದಾರ ಗುಣಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧನಾಗಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That king of noble lineage was famous for his generosity.

definition: a small, usu. hard, tumorous growth on the skin, caused by a virus; a wart.
example_en: A wart is visible on her finger.

definition: a bandit who, roving from place to place in a forest, robs passers by or plunders forest wealth; a forest brigand.
example: ಆ ದಾರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಡುಗಳ್ಳ ಪ್ರಯಾಣಿಕರನ್ನು ಲೂಟಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದ.
example_en: On that road, the forest brigand used to rob the travellers.

definition: a circlet, esp. of precious metal, often set with gems, worn on a finger as an ornament or a symbol of betrothal, marriage or as a (royal) signet etc.; a finger-ring.
example_en: The groom put a gold finger-ring on the bride.

definition: (in pl. only) the success and failure; the profit and loss.
example_en: He kept account of the business's profits and losses.

definition: the plant Zingiber cassumunnar of Zingiberaceae family.
example_en: They had grown the hāḍe plant in the garden.

definition: the act or process of weaving.
example_en: She has gained expertise in weaving.

definition: a criminal deception; a dishonest artifice or trick.
example: ಆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿ ತಗರಿಬಗರಿಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಜನರನ್ನು ಮೋಸಗೊಳಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That merchant cheated people through a dishonest trick.

definition: that which has become semisolid mass, as coagulated milk; curd; clot.
example_en: They boiled the milk and curdled it into a semisolid clot.

definition: the quality of being bright; brightness; lustre.
example: ಚಿನ್ನದ ಆಭರಣದ ಹೊಗರು ಮದುವೆಯ ಮಂಟಪವನ್ನು ಬೆಳಗಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The lustre of the gold ornament lit up the wedding pavilion.

definition: an anticipating eagerly; a looking forward in anticipation.
example_en: The students' eager anticipation for the result ended today.

definition: the direction midway between west and south; southweast.
example: ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ಹರಾಸೆಯ ಕಡೆಯಿಂದ ಬಿಸಿ ಗಾಳಿ ಬೀಸುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: In the morning a hot wind was blowing from the southwest.

definition: to begin; to start; to commence.
example_en: He began the new work today itself.

definition: a tolerating or being tolerant of another's belief, worship, religious philosophy, code of ethics, etc.; religious tolerance.
example_en: Religious tolerance is very important in this country.

definition: the mouth.
example: ಅವನು ತನ್ನ ತೊಂಡ ತೆರೆದು ಜೋರಾಗಿ ನಕ್ಕನು.
example_en: He opened his mouth and laughed loudly.

definition: hurriedly; hastily.
example_en: The soldiers rushed hurriedly into the fort.

definition: an angry dispute or altercation; a quarrel.
example: ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲೇ ಇಬ್ಬರ ನಡುವೆ ಕುತ್ತುಪೆನ ಶುರುವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Within a short time an angry quarrel broke out between the two of them.

definition: to show the path.
example_en: A villager showed the path to the travellers.

definition: to empty (the contents as of a container) completely.
example: ಅವನು ಚೀಲದಲ್ಲಿದ್ದ ಅಕ್ಕಿಯನ್ನು ತಳಹಚ್ಚಿ ಖಾಲಿ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He emptied out all the rice in the sack completely.

definition: administration lacking proper control.
example: ಆ ಇಲಾಖೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಡಿಲಾಳ್ಕೆ ಇರುವುದರಿಂದ ಅವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: Because there is loose administration in that department, disorder has increased.

definition: a person mediating between a seller and a buyer for a fee or a percentage of the sale proceeds or he who negotiates as an intermediary a contract between two or more parties for a commission; a commission agent; a broker.
example_en: The broker arranged the deal for selling the house.

definition: that which is gained, earned, accrued from one's past deeds.
example: ಈ ಆಸ್ತಿ ಅವನ ಪೂರ್ವಾರ್ಜಿತ ಪುಣ್ಯದ ಫಲ.
example_en: This wealth is the result of merit gained from his past deeds.

definition: a heavy iron lever with one end forged into a wedge; a crow-bar.
example_en: The worker lifted the heavy stone with a crow-bar.

definition: the ripe kernel of the coconut, in which the milk is dried in natural course, which yields coconut oil; copra.
example_en: Grandmother dries the copra and extracts oil from it.

definition: a catching of an elephant (for purpose of domesticating).
example_en: The elephant catching took place as per the king's order.

definition: shining in the interior; flashing or flashed in the mind.
example_en: A thought flashed in his mind.

definition: to cause to wear (as a garment ornament, etc.
example_en: The mother made her daughter wear the new dress.

definition: to flow in a stream.
example_en: The rainwater flowed in a stream and joined the river.

definition: a unit of time equal to twenty four seconds.
example_en: One vinadi consists of twenty-four seconds.

definition: a multitude of crows.
example_en: A multitude of crows was flying over the field, cawing.

definition: a covering for the hand, made of leather, cloth, etc., with a separate cover for each finger and the thumb; a glove.
example: ಕೈಗವಸ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ಹಿಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುವುದು ಕಷ್ಟ.
example_en: It is difficult to work in the snow without gloves.

definition: a usu. metal instrument by which the bolt of a lock is turned; a key.
example_en: He lost the key of the door and could not go inside.

definition: a kind ofss that brays loudly and is large in size.
example_en: The large donkey brayed loudly.

definition: any of various green leaf-insects (phasmid insects) of Phylliidae family, with wings and legs resembling leaves; walking-leaf; leaf-insect.
example_en: The leaf-insect looks like a green leaf.

definition: a man of abnormally small stature; a dwarf.
example: ಆ ಗುಡ್ಡ ಎತ್ತರದ ಜನರ ನಡುವೆ ಎದ್ದು ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿದ್ದ.
example_en: That dwarf stood out among the tall people.

definition: a mendicant in gen.
example_en: The mendicant went to the houses of the town to beg.

definition: a person designated to hear and decide cases in a court of law; a judge.
example_en: The judge announced the verdict in the court.

definition: nearness in time; proximity.
example_en: After the marriage, their proximity in time increased.

definition: not clean; not pure; impure; unclean.
example_en: The sewage water was unclean, unfit for drinking.

definition: the digestive faculty in the body.
example_en: Drinking hot water increases the digestive faculty.

definition: important but delicate (said place, position etc.); strategic (point, plan, plot etc.).
example_en: That place was a strategic point for the army.

definition: another's property.
example_en: Do not covet another's property.

definition: any of a genus (Ocimum) of fragrant plants of the mint family, esp. a white-flowered garden herb (Ocimum sanctum which is religiously regarded as a goddess).
example_en: They placed holy basil leaves before the god.

definition: to give forth or release smoke.
example: ಒಲೆ ದೂವೆಯಿಡುತ್ತಿತ್ತು, ಇಡೀ ಮನೆ ಹೊಗೆಯಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The stove was giving off smoke, and the whole house filled with it.

definition: a sharp, long beak-like nose.
example_en: Her sharp, long beak-like nose drew everyone's attention.

definition: a man who accepts; a person who signs an agreement; an acceptor.
example_en: The acceptor signed the agreement.

definition: that which cures piles.
example_en: The doctor prescribed a medicine that cures piles.

definition: the office, duty etc. of the revenue officer of a tālūka.
example_en: He was entrusted with the revenue office of the taluk.

definition: the act or fact of remaining unseen by others; a hiding (of oneself).
example_en: His hiding from everyone brought surprise to all.

definition: a vain show of one's pride.
example_en: Everyone laughed seeing his vain show of pride.

definition: loose, gritty particles of worn or disintegrated rock; sand.
example: ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಪುಣಿಲ್ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೋಟೆ ಕಟ್ಟಿ ಆಟವಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: The children played, building a fort on the sand.

definition: having only one form; that cannot change one's own form.
example: ಆ ದೇವತೆ ಏಕರೂಪಾಧೀನ ಎಂದು ಪುರಾಣ ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The scripture says that deity is one who cannot change its own form.

definition: to scrape away the surface (of something).
example_en: He scraped away the peel with a knife.

definition: kicked or trampled with the foot or feet.
example_en: That trampled cloth was covered with dirt.

definition: the relation that exists between two persons connected by blood or marriage.
example_en: He is my close relative.

definition: a bladder of water; a bubble.
example_en: Water bubbles were rising in the rainwater.

definition: the effect of one's sin or sins, in which the food becomes or seems to be a heap of worms.
example_en: Because of the fruit of his sin, he experienced the curse of food turning into worms.

definition: that much or that many as the hand can hold; a handful quantity.
example_en: He gave a handful of rice to the child.

definition: a schedule of the times certain things are to happen, as of the subjects to be taught in a school or of the times of arrival and departure of airplanes, trains, buses, etc.; time-table.
example_en: The school time-table is pasted on the notice board.

definition: to bring formal charges against (of doing wrong, breaking the law, etc.); to accuse; to charge with; to impeach.
example_en: The police brought charges of theft against him.

definition: a standard letter of a language.
example_en: The teacher wrote the standard letters on the wall.

definition: Sarasvati, the Goddess of learning.
example_en: Sarasvati grants learning and wisdom.
